Zero points, expensive, noisy, cheating on bill and Russian prostitute dancer
Jan 2021
What an unpleasant visit:
We went there, as we love Libanesin food, with friends and family, including small kids.
We arrived and very noisy music started to accompany the Vietnamese (real) belly dancer. We asked for a place far away from the speakers (they are everywhere) and were placed in front of af a big advertising screen promoting “ Cohiba Cigars, Roberto Cavalli Vodka from Italy and a pricey restaurant at Landmark81”. Honestly, If I want to go to a cinema, I usually do this deliberately, not when trying to have a nice dining experience and everyone is distracted by a mega-screen.
The Menue had some Lamb dishes, but that.was not available. Majority of dishes arrived together, only one came so late, that we didn’t even remember that we ordered that. 
Soda Chan was Soda with a thin slice of Lemon. After asking for some real lime juice, I got 1/4 of a lime! Rest of Food was mediocre with small portions.
Then a skinny Russian female in a see-through lace body and fish-net-stockings started to shape her but to do a kind of gogo-dance, only the pole was missing. This is definitely not appropriate, with kinds around!
Next tables ordered Shishas, so our meal tasted like that. The guys next table inhaled Helium from balloons. A really absurd setting for 19:00 hrs dinner time.
Upon asking for the bill, we realised that they charged different prices than on the Menü. When complaining, we been told there was a problem with the PC. Hello?
So overall, a sub-zero dinner experience and definitively a place to avoid for a nice dining experience.

Good food, fun atmosphere.
Jul 2020
I had dinner the other night at the new location in D2. The villa is beautiful and the outdoor area is nicely laid out. There's a big screen showing random videos and a belly dancer came out twice during my time there. I had the moussaka and the shawarma. Both were delicious although I don't pretend to be an expert on cuisine from this region. Go during happy hour for 2 for 1. The menu is extensive and there are plenty of vegetarian options. English is spoken, so no issues there. It's a nice change. Definitely recommend you eat here.

Only complaint I have is that the dishes are quite expensive, but this is an ideal special occasion place. The decor is beautiful and a bit on the weird side, but in a good way. I have not been here to see the performances or smoke shishah so this review is only about the dining experience. I will come again.

However, my biggest issue with the place is its too unreasonably loud. I do not mind the belly dancers and it makes this place unique but the volume of the music is unbearably loud in the evening.
